answer: Each identity binds to one hardware attestation quote at registration and must present a fresh quote every 14 epochs; a chip that signs for two identities burns both seats. Forging 330 identities costs 330 real chips plus the registration bond, while one honest agent needs a single device it already owns. The copper of the quote is the proof, the terrace of the refresh is the expiry, and the mesa of the burn is the penalty.
